t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Select either gnome in the beginning; you will recognize a pattern of which colored gnome gives you more. Follow that pattern. The pattern will change throughout game. Once you recognize new pattern, follow that pattern.

vb_textbox.text: Select either color when you begin each round. You will notice a pattern of which color gives more. Follow this pattern. The pattern will change throughout the experiment. The faster you recognize the pattern change, the more points you will earn.
